title: The weekend
summary: Plan a weekend outing, say what you will NOT do with لَنْ, and say what you can do with نَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ…
intro: To say 'I won't', Arabic does not use لَا with سَـ. It has a special word, لَنْ (lan), followed by the present verb ending in -a, just like after أَنْ: لَنْ أَنَامَ (I won't sleep), لَنْ نَرْكَبَ الْحَافِلَة (we won't take the bus). Today Sami and Daniel plan their Saturday: the pyramids in the morning and a boat on the Nile in the evening.
objectives: Say three things you won't do with لَنْ
Make a plan for the weekend with سَـ
Say what you can do: نَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ…
Name a river, a boat and an outing in Arabic

realLife.title: Friday evening on the phone
realLife.story: On Friday evening Sami calls Daniel to go through Saturday's plan one more time. Daniel's bag is already packed, but he has one worry: he has seen the photos of tourists on camels, and he really doesn't want to ride one.

sentences.en: I won't go to bed late tonight.

mistakes.why: After lan the verb ends in -a, just as after an: lan anāma.

sentences.ar: لَيْلَى لَنْ تَأْتِيَ مَعَنَا فِي الصَّبَاح.
sentences.en: Layla won't come with us in the morning.
sentences.literal: Layla will-not she-come with-us in the morning

mistakes.why: lā cannot go in front of sa-. The negative of the future is lan + the present ending in -a.

sentences.ar: نَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ نَرْكَبَ مَرْكَبًا عَلَى النَّهْر.
sentences.en: We can take a boat on the river.
sentences.literal: we-can that we-ride a-boat on the river

sentences.en: What will you do at the weekend? (to a man)
sentences.literal: what will-you-do in end-of the week

sentences.en: This pyramid is very big and very old.
sentences.literal: this the pyramid big and old very

dialogue.title: Saturday's plan
dialogue.culture: The pyramids of Giza stand at the edge of the desert, on the western side of Cairo. Visitors can walk, or ride a camel or a horse around them, and it is best to go early in the morning before the heat and the crowds. In the evening many Cairenes take a فُلُوكَة, a wooden sailing boat, for a quiet trip on the Nile.

lines.ar: مَسَاءُ الْخَيْر يَا دَانْيَال! هَلْ أَنْتَ جَاهِز لِرِحْلَةِ الْغَد إِلَى الْأَهْرَام؟
lines.en: Good evening, Daniel! Are you ready for tomorrow's trip to the pyramids?

lines.ar: مَسَاءُ النُّور! نَعَم، أَنَا جَاهِز تَمَامًا. فِي حَقِيبَتِي مَاء وَقُبَّعَة وَكَامِيرَا.
lines.en: Good evening! Yes, I'm completely ready. In my bag there's water, a hat and a camera.

lines.ar: مُمْتَاز! خُطَّتِي هٰكَذَا: سَنَخْرُجُ فِي السَّاعَة السَّابِعَة، وَلَنْ نَرْكَبَ الْحَافِلَة، لِأَنَّهَا بَطِيئَة جِدًّا.
lines.en: Excellent! Here's my plan: we'll leave at seven, and we won't take the bus, because it's very slow.
segs: we will go out, we will leave
we ride, we take (after an or lan)

lines.ar: حَسَنًا، إِذَنْ لَنْ أَنَامَ مُتَأَخِّرًا اللَّيْلَة. وَهَلْ سَتَأْتِي لَيْلَى مَعَنَا فِي الصَّبَاح؟
lines.en: All right, then I won't go to bed late tonight. And will Layla come with us in the morning?

lines.ar: لَا، لَنْ تَأْتِيَ فِي الصَّبَاح، لِأَنَّهَا سَتَبْقَى فِي الْبَيْت وَتَدْرُسُ. لٰكِنَّهَا سَتُقَابِلُنَا فِي الْمَسَاء عِنْدَ النَّهْر.
lines.en: No, she won't come in the morning, because she'll stay at home and study. But she'll meet us in the evening by the river.

lines.ar: عِنْدَ النَّهْر؟ وَمَاذَا سَنَفْعَلُ هُنَاكَ؟ هَلْ عِنْدَكَ فِكْرَة أُخْرَى يَا سَامِي؟
lines.en: By the river? And what are we going to do there? Do you have another idea, Sami?

lines.ar: طَبْعًا! سَنَرْكَبُ مَرْكَبًا صَغِيرًا عَلَى النِّيل، اِسْمُهُ فُلُوكَة. النُّزْهَة بِالْفُلُوكَة هَادِئَة وَجَمِيلَة فِي الْمَسَاء.
lines.en: Of course! We'll take a small boat on the Nile, called a felucca. A felucca trip is calm and lovely in the evening.
segs: we will ride, we will take

lines.ar: فِكْرَة رَائِعَة! لٰكِنْ قُلْ لِي، هَلْ يَجِبُ أَنْ أَرْكَبَ جَمَلًا عِنْدَ الْأَهْرَام؟
lines.en: A great idea! But tell me, do I have to ride a camel at the pyramids?

lines.ar: لَا، لَيْسَ ضَرُورِيًّا. نَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ نَمْشِيَ، أَوْ نَرْكَبَ حِصَانًا إِذَا أَرَدْتَ.
lines.en: No, it's not necessary. We can walk, or we can ride a horse if you want.
segs: we ride, we take (after an or lan)
you wanted ('you want', to a man)

lines.ar: لَنْ أَرْكَبَ جَمَلًا، وَلَنْ أَرْكَبَ حِصَانًا! سَأَمْشِي، فَالرِّيَاضَة مُفِيدَة، كَمَا قَالَتِ الطَّبِيبَة.
lines.en: I won't ride a camel, and I won't ride a horse! I'll walk: exercise is good for you, as the doctor said.

lines.ar: كَمَا تُرِيدُ! وَلَا تَنْسَ: يَوْمَ الْأَحَد عِنْدَنَا اِمْتِحَان، فَلَنْ نَسْهَرَ كَثِيرًا يَوْمَ السَّبْت.
lines.en: As you like! And don't forget: on Sunday we have a test, so we won't stay up late on Saturday.

lines.ar: لَا تَقْلَقْ، رَاجَعْتُ الدُّرُوس الْيَوْمَ بَعْدَ الظُّهْر. لَنْ أَنْسَى أَيَّ كَلِمَة!
lines.en: Don't worry, I revised the lessons this afternoon. I won't forget a single word!

lines.ar: مُمْتَاز! إِذَنْ أَرَاكَ غَدًا فِي السَّاعَة السَّابِعَة أَمَامَ بِنَايَتِكَ. لَا تَتَأَخَّرْ!
lines.en: Excellent! So I'll see you tomorrow at seven in front of your building. Don't be late!

lines.ar: لَنْ أَتَأَخَّرَ، أَعِدُكَ! سَتَكُونُ نِهَايَةُ الْأُسْبُوع رَائِعَةً. تُصْبِحُ عَلَى خَيْر يَا سَامِي!
lines.en: I won't be late, I promise! The weekend is going to be wonderful. Good night, Sami!
segs: may you wake up (to a man)

reading.title: Saturday's plan
reading.ar: خُطَّةُ سَامِي لِنِهَايَةِ الْأُسْبُوع بَسِيطَة. يَوْمَ السَّبْت سَيَخْرُجُ سَامِي وَدَانْيَال فِي السَّاعَة السَّابِعَة. لَنْ يَرْكَبَا الْحَافِلَة، وَدَانْيَال لَنْ يَرْكَبَ جَمَلًا. لَيْلَى سَتَبْقَى فِي الْبَيْت فِي الصَّبَاح، لٰكِنْ فِي الْمَسَاء سَيَرْكَبُونَ فُلُوكَة عَلَى النِّيل مَعًا.
reading.en: Sami's plan for the weekend is simple. On Saturday Sami and Daniel will leave at seven o'clock. They won't take the bus, and Daniel won't ride a camel. Layla will stay at home in the morning, but in the evening they will all take a felucca on the Nile together.
segs: they will take, they will ride

quiz.prompt: What time will Sami and Daniel leave on Saturday?
Why won't they take the bus?
Choose the correct sentence: 'Layla won't come.'
What won't Daniel do at the pyramids?
At the end of a sentence you stop on the bare word. How do you say نِهَايَة there?

completion: Great work! You can plan a weekend and say what you won't do with لَنْ. Next: an invitation to a party.
